attempt_1_disclosure.c_nw2_U_rc1_diagnosis: failed session start, masked by a harness fault. Evidence: in that session openbox logged 'Failed to open the display from the DISPLAY environment variable', picom logged 'Can't open display', the Driver logged 'X11 overlay: cannot connect to display: Connection refused' in every trial and xvfb-run's cleanup found the Xvfb pid already gone ('kill: No such process'): the private Xvfb on :99 did not come up (the open cua-x11-session display race; R2-10's N1 failed the same way). Every one of the 10 U trials then failed in run_b02.control_trial before its oracle poller started, and run_critpath.OraclePoller.stop joined that never-started thread, so the row recorded 'RuntimeError: cannot join thread before it is started' instead of the real error. Neither U nor R' was at fault; U must still fire 5/5 per class, and is re-run by attempt 2 under a new label.
